events.text: HMS Warrior was ordered by the British Royal Navy.
events.subject: self
events.quote: ordered in 1942 by the British Royal Navy

events.text: Building of the aircraft carrier was completed.
events.subject: self

events.text: The aircraft carrier was lent to the Royal Canadian Navy as HMCS Warrior.
events.subject: self
events.quote: lent to the Royal Canadian Navy from 1946 to 1948 as HMCS Warrior

events.text: The loan to the Royal Canadian Navy ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: lent to the Royal Canadian Navy from 1946 to 1948 as HMCS Warrior

events.text: Warrior was returned to the Royal Navy and entered service with the British.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Warrior was returned to the Royal Navy in 1948 and entered service with the British

events.text: Warrior was fitted with an angled flight deck.
events.subject: self
events.quote: including the installation of an angled flight deck in 1956

events.text: The ship was used in aircraft landing experiments.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1948–1949 , the ship was used in aircraft landing experiments

events.text: The use of the ship in aircraft landing experiments ended.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1948–1949 , the ship was used in aircraft landing experiments

events.text: Warrior was fitted with a rubber flight deck.
events.subject: self
events.quote: and fitted with a rubber flight deck

events.text: Warrior was used as the headquarters ship during nuclear testing at Christmas Island.
events.subject: self
events.quote: in 1957 , was used as the headquarters ship during nuclear testing at Christmas Island

events.text: The vessel was sold to the Argentine Navy.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1958 , the vessel was sold to the Argentine Navy

events.text: The ship entered Argentine service as ARA Independencia.
events.subject: self
events.quote: entered Argentine service in 1959 as ARA Independencia

events.subject: self
events.quote: remained in service until 1970 when Independencia was placed in reserve

events.text: The ship was sold for scrap.
